ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering the central and medial regions, with 25% high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in distal patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are localized to the distal third of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits a dense, mottled white patch extending from the upper trailing edge toward the tip. The right lobe shows more fragmented, vertical white streaks and mottling near the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; approximately 40-50 degree internal angle with symmetric depth reaching the base of the fluke connection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely irregular trailing edge. Left lobe shows fine, high-frequency serrations. Right lobe displays a macro-scale jagged indentation (large bite-like gap) approximately midway between the notch and the tip, surrounded by medium-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory leading to sharply tapered distal tips; leading edges (visible upper boundary) exhibit slight convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of 6-8 circular annular scars (rosettes) located on the distal upper-left lobe within the white pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible vertical and diagonal dark linear scratches crossing the white mottled regions on the distal right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent jagged traumatic indentation on the right lobe trailing edge, representing significant tissue loss compared to the left lobe's profile.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular 'o-ring' scar pattern on the far left lobe tip, consisting of perfectly circular high-contrast outlines.
